profile.headline: Modeling and Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Research Interests:
-- Designing and developing numerical methods for the analysis of science and engineering problems;
reliable and efficient solution schemes for a wide variety of problems, theoretical and computational
modeling, optimizations, inverse problems, data-driven methods, and high-performance
computing
-- Computational fracture mechanics, computational wave propagation dynamics, computational
hydrodynamics of floating flexible structures
-- Enriched finite element methods, boundary element methods, direct time integrations, mapping
approaches for singular solutions
--  Eigensolvers, linear system solvers, low-rank approximations
--  Applying data science and machine learning methods to a wide variety of problems

Major in mechanical engineering and minor in applied mathematics

Research experience in computational mechanics over 8 years

Excellent programming skills using C/C++  and Python

positions.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
positions.description:
-- Developed a scalable Bayesian inference software framework for integrating data with complex predictive models under uncertainty, which allows the user to implement a collection of sophisticated and computationally efficient Bayesian inversion algorithms.
-- Designed an effective approach based on model reduction (both parameter and state dimension reduction) to tackle the prohibitive nature of large-scale Bayesian inverse problems.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate
positions.description:
-- Developed the 3D mapped finite element method for the analysis of problems possessing
singular solutions (e.g., 3D cracks or re-entrant corners problems); implementing the method
using shared and distributed parallel processing

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
-- Developed enriched overlapping finite elements for wave propagation analyses
-- Developed a novel eigensolver, the enriched subspace iteration method, for the solutions of very
large spare symmetric linear systems; the solver achieves 3–5 times speed-up compared to the
basic subspace iteration method
-- Studied a meshless method enriched for wave propagation analyses

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
-- Developed a hydroelastic analysis (interaction between free-surface water waves and floating
elastic structures) computer program; the boundary element method for water waves and the
nonlinear finite element method (the updated Lagrangian formulation) for floating flexible
structures are employed
